name: pulser audio
changelog:
• Functional 3-Bar Sidebar Lock: Clicking the 3-bar hamburger button locks the sidebar open; selecting any track, playlist, or option closes it instantly
• Native Pulsar Flow & Discover: Replaced external YouTube Music webview with ultra-fast native online streaming, vibe radios, and zero CPU/GPU overhead
• Self-Learning Taste Engine: Learns from your listening habits, completions, skips, favorites, and playlists to recommend personalized music that gets better the more you listen
• YouTube Music 50-Track Similar Radio: Selecting any track instantly generates a continuous 50-song similar queue with infinite auto-play
• Pulsar Radar In-App Notifications: Dedicated in-app notification center for new trending hits and AI taste recommendations with 1-click playback (in addition to desktop notifications)
• Ultra-Low CPU & GPU Footprint: Hardware-accelerated 60FPS visualizer, single-instance database protection, and zero thermal throttling
